entities.title: Page bridge
entities.summary: TypeScript for the page around the Godot export, bundled into bridge.js: it starts the engine and gives the game what only the page can do.
entities.purpose: main.ts boots Godot's loader with a progress bar and a failure notice, and defines window.chessBridge; engine.ts runs Stockfish in a Web Worker and maps the eight strengths to UCI commands.
boundaries: The game calls window.chessBridge only from godot/scripts/api.gd, and only in the browser; on the desktop Api does without it.
Stockfish itself is the stockfish npm package, copied into engine/ by build.mjs and not edited here.
